mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a specific trigger condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a peak.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a specific trigger condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS has increased over the past 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs pressure corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a labor market deterioration, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the central bank's policy shift dampens economic activity and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
